about: Cases where Lucebox's prompt still differs from the official template, with the reason, per model and prompt path (<model>/codec: --chat-codec; /codec_official: the codec with preserve_thinking false, Qwen3.5's official prompt; /jinja: the Jinja engine with the official template). test_chat_golden_* fails on a difference not listed here and on a listed case that matches. `text` compares the rendered prompt; `tokens` compares token IDs (only with a real GGUF tokenizer).

qwen3.8-flash-next/jinja.whitespace_edges: the Jinja engine's trim strips ASCII whitespace only (Python's also strips Unicode spaces such as U+00A0 and U+3000)
qwen3.8-flash-next/jinja.float_values: the Jinja engine's tojson writes floats as C++ does (1e+15), not as Python's json.dumps (1000000000000000.0)

deepseek-v4.1-flash/codec.official_3: the encoder's latest_reminder role, which no API request can send: the codec rejects the conversation
deepseek-v4.1-flash/codec.official_4: the encoder's latest_reminder role, which no API request can send: the codec rejects the conversation
deepseek-v4.1-flash/codec.official_5: image parts are not rendered on this path: the server renders images through its image pipeline, which this test does not drive

qwen3.5-27b/codec.history_reasoning_alias: deliberate: the codec keeps earlier turns' thinking by default (the Qwen3.5 template drops it, as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp and Ollama do), so a new user question leaves the history as it was for the prefix cache and PFlash; preserve_thinking false renders the official prompt (qwen3.5-27b/codec_official)
